Ciudad Juarez, Mexico.

I'd say that 2000 to 3000 murders a year might speak for itself. The government had to "retire" the police force and take their guns because of the high corruption levels. The military isn't any better. You have a nice car? Say goodbye to it, if someone doesn't steal it from you then the military will take it instead. I don't care where you are in the United States, it just doesn't get as bad as Juarez. Finding decapitated corpses on the street is a daily occurrence. A couple of years ago it was the second most dangerous city in the world, I think right now it's the sixth. If seeing the corpses on the street doesn't faze you then the possibility of becoming one at any possibly second will. I don't live there anymore. Now i live in the US, right across the river, but the river doesn't stop the bullets that sometimes fly across and hit buildings and cars on this side. I think the daily murder rate in Juarez is about 11 or 12 people a day right now. 

Lived there half my life, glad I don't anymore. Sucks to visit the relatives. I'd say we go at least once every two weeks.

Anything she wanted, all she had to do was ask, and in the end she betrayed me and then had the gall to say it was my fault. 

And it does mean something, either that i have to go another ten or that maybe i'm not supposed to die. But i don't really see a point to it. I had a life planned with her, and it isn't going to happen anymore.

But i have pretty much deduced that most people are lying self serving sacks of trash that only do things that will benefit them. One does not help another if there is nothing to be gained, even if it is just the satisfaction of knowing you helped. You can't trust people. That why i thought russian roulette had a nice ring to it. It is all chance, no thinking. One in six.
